// === BLOC 1 : Creation de la table & politiques temps reel ===
.create table pharmacy_shortage_events (
    event_time: datetime,
    hospital_id: string,
    region: string,
    cis_code: string,
    cip13: string,
    stock_level: int,
    alert_severity: string
)

.alter table pharmacy_shortage_events policy ingestionbatching '{"MaximumBatchingTimeSpan": "00:00:10", "MaximumNumberOfItems": 500, "MaximumRawDataSizeMB": 100}'

.alter table pharmacy_shortage_events policy retention '{"SoftDeletePeriod": "365.00:00:00", "Recoverability": "Enabled"}'

.alter table pharmacy_shortage_events policy caching hot = 30d

// === BLOC 2 : Simulation d'evenements streaming (.ingest inline) ===
.ingest inline into table pharmacy_shortage_events <|
2026-11-10T02:05:00Z,CHU_LYON,Auvergne-Rhone-Alpes,60234100,3400935955838,0,CRITICAL
2026-11-10T02:12:00Z,APHP_PARIS,Ile-de-France,60234100,3400935955838,2,WARNING
2026-11-10T02:18:00Z,CHU_TOULOUSE,Occitanie,60485234,3400930001234,0,CRITICAL
2026-11-10T02:25:00Z,APHP_PARIS,Ile-de-France,60234100,3400935955838,0,CRITICAL
2026-11-10T02:42:00Z,CHU_LILLE,Hauts-de-France,60234100,3400935955838,1,WARNING
2026-11-10T03:05:00Z,CHU_LYON,Auvergne-Rhone-Alpes,60485234,3400930001234,0,CRITICAL

// === BLOC 3A : Agregation horaire avec bin() ===
pharmacy_shortage_events
| where alert_severity == "CRITICAL"
| summarize critical_alerts = count(), hospitals = dcount(hospital_id) by bin(event_time, 1h), region
| order by event_time desc

// === BLOC 3B : Serie temporelle continue (make-series) + Graphique ===
pharmacy_shortage_events
| make-series total_events = count() default = 0
    on event_time from datetime(2026-11-10T02:00:00Z) to datetime(2026-11-10T04:00:00Z) step 15m
    by alert_severity
| render timechart

// === BLOC 4 : Enrichissement Temps Reel via OneLake Shortcut (gold_dim_drug) ===
pharmacy_shortage_events
| where event_time > ago(24h) and alert_severity == "CRITICAL"
| join kind=leftouter (
    gold_dim_drug | project cis_code, denomination, is_mitm, substance_active_primary
) on cis_code
| project event_time, hospital_id, region, cis_code, denomination, is_mitm, substance_active_primary, stock_level
| order by event_time desc
